title: OCPP Sessions (lab)
description: Per-session charging data read from TimescaleDB (meter_samples hypertable) — the product-data plane, deliberately separate from the Prometheus ops metrics on the registry dashboard. Previews hydecharge-ocpi ADR-0003: raw samples stay raw in the store; normalization (kWh→Wh) happens in the query as a projection. The internal sim only reports Energy.Active.Export.Register — power and SoC panels fill in when a real charger connects.

list.name: chargepoint
list.label: charge point
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT charge_point FROM meter_samples ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT charge_point FROM meter_samples ORDER BY 1

list.name: session
list.label: session (tx)
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT transaction_id FROM meter_samples WHERE transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 50
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT transaction_id FROM meter_samples WHERE transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Energy register — session $session
panels.description: Cumulative energy register readings for the selected transaction, normalized to Wh in the query (the store keeps the raw value + unit). The sim's register grows ~2 Wh per sample.

defaults.noValue: No energy samples for this session yet

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", measurand || CASE WHEN phase <> '' THEN ' ' || phase ELSE '' END AS metric, value * CASE WHEN unit IN ('kWh','kW') THEN 1000 ELSE 1 END AS value FROM meter_samples WHERE transaction_id = $session AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND measurand LIKE 'Energy%' ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Power — session $session
panels.description: Instantaneous power samples for the selected transaction, normalized to W in the query.

defaults.noValue: No power samples — the internal sim only reports the energy register. Power (and SoC) appear when a real charger connects.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", measurand || CASE WHEN phase <> '' THEN ' ' || phase ELSE '' END AS metric, value * CASE WHEN unit = 'kW' THEN 1000 ELSE 1 END AS value FROM meter_samples WHERE transaction_id = $session AND charge_point = '$chargepoint' AND measurand LIKE 'Power%' ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Sessions per day (all charge points)
panels.description: Distinct transactions per day across the fleet — time_bucket('1 day') over the dashboard range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 day', ts) AS "time", count(DISTINCT transaction_id) AS "sessions" FROM meter_samples WHERE transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Recent sessions
panels.description: Latest 25 transactions with sample counts and the energy-register span (max − min per measurand, normalized to Wh). Ignores the dashboard time range so the session picker always has context.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.transaction_id AS "tx", s.charge_point AS "charge point", min(s.first_ts) AS "first sample", max(s.last_ts) AS "last sample", sum(s.n)::int AS "energy samples", max(s.span_wh) AS "energy Wh (register span)" FROM (SELECT transaction_id, charge_point, measurand, min(ts) AS first_ts, max(ts) AS last_ts, count(*) AS n, round((max(value * CASE WHEN unit IN ('kWh','kW') THEN 1000 ELSE 1 END) - min(value * CASE WHEN unit IN ('kWh','kW') THEN 1000 ELSE 1 END))::numeric, 1) AS span_wh FROM meter_samples WHERE transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND measurand LIKE 'Energy%' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) s GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY max(s.last_ts) DESC LIMIT 25
